name: scrs
description: Runs the SCRS backend (server/) and frontend (client/) together for local development.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:nomail: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "SMTP_HOST= npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
